LCS_LENGTH(X, Y)
1  m <- length[X]
2  n <- length[Y]
3  for i <- 1 to m
4       do c[i, 0] <- 0
5  for j <- 1 to n
6       do c[0, j] <- 0
7  for i <- 1 to m
8       do for j <- 1 to n
9            do if x_i = y_j
10                 then c[i, j] <- __AAA__
11                      b[i, j] <- "↖"
12                 else if c[i-1, j] >= __BBB__
13                      then c[i, j] <- c[i-1, j]
14                           b[i, j] <- "↑"
15                      else c[i, j] <- __CCC__
16                           b[i, j] <- "←"
17 return __DDD__
選出正確的
